source_claim: For one independently locked task, an eligible complete paper-derived skill can be compiled into a source-anchored, dependency-relative one-deletion-minimal procedural slice with sealed confirmation that its paired net effect is equivalent to the complete artifact and that every retained dependency atom is locally necessary.

axes.problem: Rapidly extract the task-relevant operational core of a paper without mistaking semantic relevance, dependency completeness, executability, or a null full artifact for preserved usefulness.
axes.mechanism: A beneficial-full-effect eligibility gate, frozen source and dependency atomization, adaptive discovery with alpha spending, sealed paired confirmation, and simultaneous effect-equivalence, contract, guardrail, and failed-removal certificates.
axes.insight: The operational core is task-local and behavioral: only an eligible full artifact may be reduced, and the result is locally irreducible relative to a declared atomization rather than globally smallest or transferable.
axes.application: PaperToSkill artifacts and independently locked user tasks.
axes.evaluation_scope: Eight development replays plus at least four genuinely new held-out paper-task cases, reported separately with effect equivalence, contract and guardrail noninferiority, procedure count, and cost.

comparisons.title: Graph-of-Skills: Dependency-Aware Structural Retrieval for Massive Agent Skills
comparisons.evidence: Graph-of-Skills constructs executable dependency graphs and retrieves bounded dependency-aware bundles; it does not first prove a beneficial complete-artifact effect or seal per-task effect-equivalence and failed-removal certificates on untouched runs.
comparisons.limitations: It defeats broad novelty claims about dependency-aware compact skill selection.

comparisons.title: SkillRAE: Agent Skill-Based Context Compilation for Retrieval-Augmented Execution
comparisons.evidence: SkillRAE compiles compact, grounded, task-specific contexts and rescues key evidence, but its abstract does not define a beneficial-full-effect gate or seal local equivalence to a complete artifact under retained-atom deletion.

comparisons.title: ClawTrace: Cost-Aware Tracing for LLM Agent Skill Distillation
comparisons.evidence: ClawTrace compiles preserve, prune, and repair patches from cost-attributed traces and analyzes rule-type quality effects, but does not gate on a beneficial full artifact or certify sealed task-local equivalence and dependency-relative failed removals.

comparisons.title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
comparisons.evidence: The framework measures whole-skill marginal utility with and without a skill; it neither reduces one skill artifact nor certifies an effect-equivalent locally irreducible subset.
comparisons.limitations: It supplies the strongest whole-skill utility baseline and defeats broad skill-utility novelty claims.

comparisons.title: Anything2Skill: Compiling External Knowledge into Reusable Skills for Agents
comparisons.evidence: Anything2Skill compiles evidence windows into structured procedural contracts but does not behaviorally reduce an eligible complete artifact against its sealed local-effect reference.
comparisons.limitations: It defeats broad claims about first evidence-grounded skill compilation.

comparisons.title: SkillFoundry: Automated Mining and Validation of Agent Skills for Scientific Tasks
comparisons.evidence: SkillFoundry mines and validates executable scientific skills and evaluates downstream utility, but does not emit an eligibility-gated sealed equivalence and failed-removal certificate relative to the full artifact.
comparisons.limitations: The overlap is substantial at compilation, validation, and downstream evaluation layers.

limitations: Candidate-specific external collision terms were not transmitted; the assessment reuses local structured evidence.
Behavior-preserving program reduction, statistical delta debugging, prompt pruning, and minimal-sufficient-rationale families remain unresolved parametric threats.

One-deletion minimality, paired equivalence testing, provenance, dependency closure, and deletion search are prior tools; novelty is restricted to their binding in the eligibility-gated, source-grounded, sealed task-local effect-preservation certificate and worker contract.
The method is scoped to at most 16 frozen dependency atoms and one locked task per certificate; it makes no global-minimum, cross-task, or cross-paper claim.
